title: nan
authors: Mostafa M.M.R.; Sever M.; Huynh V.; Jaeger N.; Jarvis A.; Hutton J.; Kurz S.
key_contribution: Assesses a commercial SLAM-based technology for simultaneous point cloud and trajectory optimization in GNSS-denied environments (deep urban canyons) using LiDAR and inertial data.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
